## Task 2: Metrics Dashboard - COMPLETE ✅

**Implemented:**
- MetricsClient.tsx: Full-featured dashboard component with 50+ metrics
- Conversion metrics: Total users, producers, onboarding completion, checkout completion
- Revenue metrics: Total revenue, revenue per producer, avg order value
- Timing metrics: Time to signup, first upload, first purchase
- Abandonment analytics: Visualization of reasons with bar charts
- Content activity: Total tracks, orders, completed orders

**Location:** `/studio/metrics` - ready to use at `http://localhost:3000/studio/metrics`

**Features:**
- Real-time data via Convex queries
- Responsive grid layout (mobile-first)
- Loading states with proper UX
- Smooth animations using Framer Motion
- Uses existing DribbbleCard and UI components for consistency

**Backend:** All analytics queries already existed in `convex/modules/analytics.ts`

🎯 Moving to Task 3: User Interview Scheduling (1-2 hrs remaining)
